sources.title: Download Trickster Theta 4 70B i1 IQ3_M GGUF · 30.2 GB
sources.snippet: Trickster Theta 4 70B i1 is a 70B parameter Llama3 language model. Fine-tuned for instruction following and conversational AI. Available in GGUF format for fast local inference with llama.cpp, guIDE, LM Studio, and Ollama. Download the IQ3_M quantisation (30.2 GB, i-quant — efficient compression with good quality.) — no redirect, starts immediately.
